title: Heard he then in that clap the voice of the god Bringforth
html_source: This alludes to Genesis Chapter Three. Verse 16 has God proclaim to Eve, “in sorrow shalt thou bring forth children, but, in keeping with the theme of this chapter of Ulysses, the inference is that the commandment to "Bringforth” is being directed at Ireland’s young men.
